author: Slvrflash
body:
We are a team of dedicated, active, close-knit minecraft architects who love having fun, building, and using creativity to construct unique maps. We frequently participate in competitions and have fun making maps for many gamemodes. If you would like to join, please follow the instructions below.

How to Apply:

  • Please reply to this post with the following.
Application Format:
IGN:
Skype:
Microphone: (yes or no)
Timezone:
Skills: (i.e. terraforming, plugins, yml, etc)
Picture or link to example build: (can be tested if you do not have one)
Extra info: (not required)

Requirements:
- must be fairly active
- mature and respectful
- building experience

If your application is accepted, you will be notified through Skype.

Members:


Co-owners: ScriptingCookies and Slvrflash

Apps are closed currently. Thanks to all who applied.
